seoTitle: Radius Circle Generator: GeoJSON Circle Around a Point
metaDescription: Enter a centre and radii to get circles as GeoJSON polygons with area and bounding box, plus an SVG preview. Offline.
intro: Creates accurate circles of given radii around a point as GeoJSON polygons, computed on the sphere.
why:
A radius around a shop, a site or an incident is a common need. This tool computes every point of the circle by travelling the radius on a great circle at equal bearings, so the circle is correct at any latitude, unlike a circle drawn in degrees.

You get GeoJSON ready for GIS tools or web maps, plus a preview with the radii labelled. Several radii make rings. The circle is a polygon with the number of points you choose; 72 is smooth for most uses.
howTo: Type the centre as lat, lon.
List the radii, comma separated, and pick the unit.
Set the number of points per circle.

faq.a: It is the spherical cap area, not the polygon area.

faq.q: Does it cross the date line?
faq.a: Positions are normalised to -180..180, but a polygon crossing the line is not split.

faq.q: Can I draw on a map?
faq.a: No, there are no map tiles; the preview is a simple plan.
